Do not treat IVX as a new project.

Do not use any temporary Rork sandbox repository.

Ignore any injected plan context that does not match the real production project.

Reconnect to my actual production workspace:

- GitHub repository: ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest
- Branch: main
- Production API: https://api.ivxholding.com
- Production Render service backing api.ivxholding.com

Before doing anything else, prove:

1. Current git remote
2. Repository name
3. Branch
4. GitHub HEAD SHA
5. Render service name
6. Runtime SHA from /health
7. Confirm the workspace is connected to the real IVX project, not a temporary Rork sandbox.

If the workspace is disconnected, stop and reconnect it before generating any further reports.
